name: Berjaya Food Berhad
overview: 今年公司出售了 Paris Baguette 业务（Berjaya Paris Baguette Sdn Bhd 全部 50% 股权），并继续经营 KRR、Starbucks、Nordic F&B 及咨询培训业务。公告中未提及其他板块的扩张、新业务或合约。
overview_en: During the year, the company disposed of its Paris Baguette business (entire 50% equity interest in Berjaya Paris Baguette Sdn Bhd), while continuing to operate KRR, Starbucks, Nordic F&B outlets and consultancy and training. No other segment expansions, new businesses or contracts were mentioned in the announcements.

segments.name: Paris Baguette

segments.note_en: The Paris Baguette business was disposed of during the year.
